initial_application: Jira says the broader request was completed during STU3 QA. No commit explicitly names FHIR-12363, but git history shows 6b1a596ff193eb074b209f3e88c3d04fdaf158dd adding endpoint reference search rows for Location.endpoint, Organization.endpoint, and PractitionerRole.endpoint, and 1a2593c7e73bdcfb2048b52db27ae6869c97daad adding HealthcareService.endpoint and its endpoint search row. Later source rework converted these search definitions into the current bundle-*-search-params.xml files.
